confidence_notes: Overall low confidence. The food and drink searches covered Kathmandu-level aggregated listings (2024–2026, some undated or dated 2024–2025), not Nagarkot specifically, so I adjusted them upward modestly for a tourist hill village. Restaurant meal anchors are the most reliable. Cocktail and beer rest on mixed venue and shop data. The wine anchor has no direct price data and is derived from the local beer relationship. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the Nagarkot guesthouse context; no live listings or booking pages were checked. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA daily table and was not verified against the F11 file directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kathmandu aggregated restaurant and drink price points, adjusted upward for Nagarkot's hill-tourism context and thinner bar and restaurant supply. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for the Nagarkot lodge and guesthouse market, not based on current listings.
